name: 地図と目的別提案を組み合わせる旅先探索面
useCase: 旅行計画の行き先案を地図と説明付き候補から探す。
boundary: Travel-inspiration map with prompt and fare pins, cash/customize controls, and a destination result sheet containing images, travel dates and prices.
observedInteraction: The prompt is Winter mountain escape, Cash is selected, and the sheet reports five destinations. Denver and Salt Lake City are visible with Jun 12–16 dates and round-trip prices.
